text: ようかいえきで　とかされてしまう。

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing happens completely, often to your regret. とかされてしまう = 'you end up dissolved'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: The される ending turns 'dissolve' into 'be dissolved': it is done to you. とかされてしまう = 'you get dissolved completely'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing shows what is used to do it. ようかいえきで = 'with dissolving fluid'.
